traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and enumerated requirements for story 010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS are fully implemented and verified: - Core functionality (storyPathPattern, requirementIdPattern and their example counterparts) is provided via both nested (story/req) and flat shorthand options in AnnotationRuleOptions, wired into valid-annotation-format. - Backward compatibility is maintained by default regex patterns and examples; when options are omitted or invalid, the rule falls back to these defaults while continuing to operate and auto-fix safely. - Pattern validation is performed by resolvePattern; invalid regex sources are detected, surfaced as explicit configuration errors, and default patterns are used instead. - Error messages use configurable story and requirement examples, with tests confirming that custom examples and nested-over-flat precedence are reflected in the emitted details. - ESLint/JSON Schema configuration for these options is defined in getRuleSchema and validated by dedicated tests, ensuring types and option shapes are correct. - Integration with valid-story-reference is consistent: both rules share default directory conventions (docs/stories) and valid-story-reference’s own configuration and tests confirm compatible behavior for storyDirectories and path handling. - User documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md documents the new pattern and example options (nested and flat), their defaults, precedence, and usage examples, aligning with the story’s configuration examples.
Given the code, tests, and documentation all align with the story’s requirements and the targeted tests pass, the story is assessed as PASSED.
